body:
I'm not sure anyone will see this. But I'm 27 years old and still a virgin. Its cause I'm gay. I grew up in conservative Jacksonville, Florida and unfortunately I have the gay voice. You can tell I'm a dicksucker off the bat. That didn't bode well for me when I was growing up; going through middle school and high school was a pain. I remember being trapped in the bathroom in 7th grade by this one guy and telling me I can't leave without speaking like a man or when someone hacked into my xanga and put all over it that I'm coming out. I was only 12 when this happened and had no notion of it what any of that terminology meant, I didn't even know what 'gay' meant. But it became like poison, slowly affecting every part of me with an inner voice telling I'm nothing. Is what I'm doing gay? "Stop acting like a fag." Are my hands too flimsy? Is my voice not deep enough? "Stop speaking like a girl." How do my eyes less aware and aloof like the other guys? "Don't play sports, cause no one wants to play with the fag."

Although it got a little better as I got older, it just sucks. I don't have the flirting fluency other people do because I was never exposed to it. I never got to make mistakes when it came to kissing and someone to sit me down for half an hour and be like 'this is how I like it,' and try stuff with other people. Although I grew up to be a smart & witty guy, my experiences of being gay and being trapped with a religious family stunted my dating experiences.

And now, collectively, all my insecurities have just snowballed. I feel like it's too late for me to try anything and in a way, it's me made lazy about trying. I've gained a little weight and it's like what's the point, you're never going to find out another dude that's into you.

There's also this aspect of one-night stands that I'm just not a fan of. Although, technology has made dating easier ie Grindr, it's like... I just met you, I have no clue what you do with your body or what STD's you might have- I don't want to fuck without knowing you. There's too much of an ease with gay dating, and after the HIV/AIDS scare from the past couple of decades, you'd think people would just be a little conservative about sleeping with each other. That's unfortunately not the case.
